description: This file defines the ProgramWorkflowService interface, which provides methods for managing programs, program workflows, program states, patient programs, concept state conversions, and related entities within the OpenMRS system. It includes methods for CRUD operations, retrieval by UUID, and querying functions specific to the domain of healthcare programs and workflows.

classes.name: ProgramWorkflowService
classes.description: Interface providing domain-specific methods for managing programs, workflows, states, and patient program data within the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: setProgramWorkflowDAO
methods.description: Setter for the ProgramWorkflow Data Access Object used for database operations related to program workflows.

methods.name: saveProgram
methods.description: Saves a Program object to the database, creating or updating as necessary.

methods.name: getProgram
methods.description: Retrieves a Program by its primary key.

methods.name: getProgramByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Program by its exact name.

methods.name: getAllPrograms
methods.description: Returns a list of all programs, including retired ones.

methods.name: getAllPrograms
methods.description: Returns a list of all programs, with optional inclusion of retired programs.

methods.name: getPrograms
methods.description: Returns programs matching a name fragment.

methods.name: purgeProgram
methods.description: Permanently deletes a Program from the database.

methods.name: purgeProgram
methods.description: Deletes a Program, optionally cascading deletion of related entities.

methods.name: retireProgram
methods.description: Retires (deactivates) a program with a specified reason.

methods.name: unretireProgram
methods.description: Reactivates a retired program.

methods.name: getProgramByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Program by its UUID.

methods.name: getPatientStateByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a PatientState by UUID.

methods.name: savePatientProgram
methods.description: Saves a PatientProgram to the database, creating or updating.

methods.name: getPatientProgram
methods.description: Retrieves a PatientProgram by its primary key.

methods.name: getPatientPrograms
methods.description: Query for PatientPrograms based on various parameters like patient, program, date ranges, and whether to include voided.

methods.name: purgePatientProgram
methods.description: Deletes a PatientProgram from the database.

methods.name: purgePatientProgram
methods.description: Deletes a PatientProgram, with optional cascading delete.

methods.name: voidPatientProgram
methods.description: Voids (soft deletes) a PatientProgram with a reason.

methods.name: unvoidPatientProgram
methods.description: Reverses the void status of a PatientProgram.

methods.name: getPossibleOutcomes
methods.description: Returns outcome concepts associated with a program.

methods.name: getWorkflow
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflow by its internal ID.

methods.name: getWorkflowByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflow by UUID.

methods.name: saveConceptStateConversion
methods.description: Saves a ConceptStateConversion entity.

methods.name: getConceptStateConversion
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptStateConversion by its primary key.

methods.name: getAllConceptStateConversions
methods.description: Retrieves all ConceptStateConversions.

methods.name: purgeConceptStateConversion
methods.description: Deletes a ConceptStateConversion from the database.

methods.name: purgeConceptStateConversion
methods.description: Deletes a ConceptStateConversion with optional cascade deletion.

methods.name: getConceptStateConversion
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptStateConversion matching a ProgramWorkflow and trigger concept.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflowState by ID.

methods.name: getStateByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflowState by UUID.

methods.name: getPatientProgramByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a PatientProgram by UUID.

methods.name: getPatientPrograms
methods.description: Fetches PatientPrograms based on cohort and collection of programs.

methods.name: getProgramsByConcept
methods.description: Returns a list of programs that use a specific concept.

methods.name: getProgramWorkflowsByConcept
methods.description: Returns workflows using a specific concept.

methods.name: getProgramWorkflowStatesByConcept
methods.description: Returns workflow states using a specific concept.

methods.name: getConceptStateConversionByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a ConceptStateConversion by UUID.

methods.name: getAllProgramAttributeTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all ProgramAttributeType entities.

methods.name: getProgramAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramAttributeType by ID.

methods.name: getProgramAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramAttributeType by UUID.

methods.name: saveProgramAttributeType
methods.description: Saves a ProgramAttributeType.

methods.name: purgeProgramAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes a ProgramAttributeType.

methods.name: getPatientProgramAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a PatientProgramAttribute by UUID.

methods.name: getPatientProgramAttributeByAttributeName
methods.description: Returns a map of patient program attributes filtered by attribute name for a list of patients.

methods.name: getPatientProgramByAttributeNameAndValue
methods.description: Returns PatientPrograms matching attribute name and value.
